screen.lead: Push the orange flat through the badge slot.
screen.text: Start from the screen side and bring it out on the back, towards the connector. Do not crease it.

screen.title: Slide the connector open
screen.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 640 340" role="img" aria-label="Back of the badge: the black sliding lock moves to the right">
              <rect width="640" height="340" fill="#C0392F"/>
              <path d="M0 300 L120 340 M0 260 L60 340" stroke="#141413" stroke-width="10" fill="none"/>
              <rect x="112" y="50" width="60" height="240" rx="4" fill="#F4F1EA"/>
              <rect x="174" y="50" width="36" height="240" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#141413" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="8 6"/>
              <rect x="210" y="50" width="36" height="240" rx="3" fill="#141413"/>
              <text x="180" y="316" text-anchor="middle" fill="#F4F1EA" font-family="Lato, sans-serif" font-size="12">sliding lock, 50 pin</text>
              <rect x="440" y="50" width="36" height="240" rx="4" fill="#0d0d0d"/>
              <rect x="300" y="80" width="170" height="180" fill="#E5A02B"/>
              <path d="M300 100H440M300 116H440M300 132H440M300 148H440M300 164H440M300 180H440M300 196H440M300 212H440M300 228H440M300 244H440" stroke="#a86f12" stroke-width="2"/>
              <path d="M118 170 H198" stroke="#F4F1EA" stroke-width="5" marker-end="url(#ar)" fill="none"/>
              <text x="158" y="34" text-anchor="middle" fill="#F4F1EA" font-family="Evogria, Lato, sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="18">SLIDE RIGHT</text>
            </svg>
screen.text: On the back, grip the black bar with a fingernail and slide it to the right a couple of millimetres until it stops. It does not flip up.

screen.title: Insert the flat
screen.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 640 340" role="img" aria-label="Back of the badge: the flat slides into the open connector">
              <rect width="640" height="340" fill="#C0392F"/>
              <path d="M0 300 L120 340 M0 260 L60 340" stroke="#141413" stroke-width="10" fill="none"/>
              <rect x="210" y="50" width="36" height="240" rx="3" fill="#141413"/>
              <rect x="112" y="50" width="60" height="240" rx="4" fill="#F4F1EA"/>
              <rect x="440" y="50" width="36" height="240" rx="4" fill="#0d0d0d"/>
              <rect x="215" y="80" width="90" height="180" fill="none" stroke="#F4F1EA" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="8 6" rx="2"/>
              <rect x="305" y="80" width="165" height="180" fill="#E5A02B"/>
              <path d="M305 100H440M305 116H440M305 132H440M305 148H440M305 164H440M305 180H440M305 196H440M305 212H440M305 228H440M305 244H440" stroke="#a86f12" stroke-width="2"/>
              <path d="M410 170 H255" stroke="#141413" stroke-width="12" fill="none"/>
              <path d="M410 170 H255" stroke="#F4F1EA" stroke-width="5" marker-end="url(#ar)" fill="none"/>
              <text x="330" y="316" text-anchor="middle" fill="#F4F1EA" font-family="Lato, sans-serif" font-size="13">straight in, all the way</text>
            </svg>
screen.lead: Slide the flat into the connector.
screen.text: With the lock open, push the flat in straight and without force until it stops, edges aligned.

screen.title: Slide the connector closed
screen.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 640 340" role="img" aria-label="Back of the badge: the black sliding lock moves to the left, securing the flat">
              <rect width="640" height="340" fill="#C0392F"/>
              <path d="M0 300 L120 340 M0 260 L60 340" stroke="#141413" stroke-width="10" fill="none"/>
              <rect x="440" y="50" width="36" height="240" rx="4" fill="#0d0d0d"/>
              <rect x="215" y="80" width="255" height="180" fill="#E5A02B"/>
              <path d="M250 100H440M250 116H440M250 132H440M250 148H440M250 164H440M250 180H440M250 196H440M250 212H440M250 228H440M250 244H440" stroke="#a86f12" stroke-width="2"/>
              <rect x="112" y="50" width="60" height="240" rx="4" fill="#F4F1EA"/>
              <rect x="210" y="50" width="36" height="240" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#141413" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="8 6"/>
              <rect x="174" y="50" width="36" height="240" rx="3" fill="#141413"/>
              <path d="M242 170 H182" stroke="#F4F1EA" stroke-width="5" marker-end="url(#ar)" fill="none"/>
              <text x="212" y="34" text-anchor="middle" fill="#F4F1EA" font-family="Evogria, Lato, sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="18">SLIDE LEFT</text>
              <circle cx="560" cy="80" r="40" fill="#F4F1EA"/>
              <path d="M540 80 L555 96 L582 62" stroke="#141413" stroke-width="9" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
            </svg>
screen.lead: Slide the black lock back to the left.
screen.text: Slide the black bar to the left until it is flush with the connector. The flat is now locked: give it a gentle tug to check.

screen.title: Peel and stick the screen
screen.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 640 340" role="img" aria-label="Left: peel the film off the double-sided strips on the screen back. Right: press the screen into the rectangular frame on the badge.">
              <rect width="640" height="340" fill="#1c1b1a"/>
              <text x="30" y="34" fill="#9db8ee" font-family="Lato, sans-serif" font-size="13" letter-spacing="2">A · PEEL THE STRIPS</text>
              <rect x="50" y="60" width="190" height="240" rx="4" fill="#b9b6ae" stroke="#F4F1EA" stroke-width="3"/>
              <rect x="50" y="60" width="32" height="240" fill="#d9c48a"/><rect x="208" y="60" width="32" height="240" fill="#d9c48a"/>
              <path d="M50 60 Q30 40 20 20" fill="none" stroke="#d9c48a" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/>
              <path d="M240 60 Q260 40 272 20" fill="none" stroke="#d9c48a" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/>
              <text x="145" y="190" text-anchor="middle" fill="#141413" font-family="Evogria, Lato, sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="20">SCREEN</text>
              <text x="145" y="212" text-anchor="middle" fill="#141413" font-family="Lato, sans-serif" font-size="12">(back)</text>
              <path d="M290 180 H336" stroke="#F4F1EA" stroke-width="4" marker-end="url(#ar)" fill="none"/>
              <text x="375" y="34" fill="#9db8ee" font-family="Lato, sans-serif" font-size="13" letter-spacing="2">B · PRESS IN THE FRAME</text>
              <rect x="360" y="60" width="260" height="260" rx="8" fill="#C0392F"/>
              <rect x="392" y="130" width="196" height="150" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#F4F1EA" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="8 6"/>
              <rect x="400" y="292" width="180" height="10" rx="3" fill="#0d0d0d"/>
              <rect x="392" y="80" width="196" height="150" rx="4" fill="#b9b6ae" stroke="#F4F1EA" stroke-width="3"/>
              <text x="490" y="126" text-anchor="middle" fill="#141413" font-family="Evogria, Lato, sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="18">SCREEN</text>
              <path d="M490 150 V250" stroke="#141413" stroke-width="12" fill="none"/>
              <path d="M490 150 V250" stroke="#F4F1EA" stroke-width="5" marker-end="url(#ar)" fill="none"/>
            </svg>
screen.lead: Remove the film, then press the screen into the frame.
screen.text: Peel the film off both double-sided strips, line the screen up with the rectangular frame and press firmly all around.

battery.text: The speaker is already attached to its small header. The bigger white header below it is where the battery plugs in.

              <text x="262" y="132" text-anchor="middle" fill="#F4F1EA" font-family="Evogria, Lato, sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="18">LIFT A LITTLE</text>

battery.lead: Raise the two speaker wires slightly.
battery.text: Lift them a few millimetres off the board so there is a gap underneath. Do not unplug the speaker.

              <path d="M150 192 Q150 236 250 232 Q340 228 344 118" stroke="#F4F1EA" stroke-width="8" fill="none"/><path d="M150 192 Q150 236 250 232 Q340 228 344 118" stroke="#141413" stroke-width="4" fill="none"/>
              <path d="M195 194 Q205 216 260 214 Q356 210 356 118" stroke="#141413" stroke-width="8" fill="none"/><path d="M195 194 Q205 216 260 214 Q356 210 356 118" stroke="#E63131" stroke-width="4" fill="none"/>
              <rect x="330" y="96" width="36" height="46" rx="3" fill="#F4F1EA"/>
              <rect x="326" y="84" width="44" height="32" rx="3" fill="#F4F1EA" stroke="#141413" stroke-width="2"/>
              <rect x="304" y="234" width="72" height="34" rx="3" fill="#F4F1EA" stroke="#141413" stroke-width="2"/>
              <path d="M340 320 V284" stroke="#141413" stroke-width="12" fill="none"/><path d="M340 320 V284" stroke="#F4F1EA" stroke-width="5" marker-end="url(#ar)" fill="none"/>
              <text x="410" y="228" fill="#F4F1EA" font-family="Evogria, Lato, sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="16">UNDER THE WIRES</text>

battery.lead: Pass the battery cable under the speaker wires, then plug it in.
battery.text: Slide the battery cable through the gap and press its plug into the large white header. Then let the speaker wires rest back down.

              <rect x="266" y="236" width="60" height="30" rx="3" fill="#F4F1EA" stroke="#141413" stroke-width="2"/>

battery.lead: Fix the battery in its frame with the double-sided tape supplied.
battery.text: Stick the separate double-sided tape strips inside the rectangular frame, then press the battery down onto them. Keep the cable clear of the screen flat.
